reply.text:
That sounds like a knee symptom, and that one is for a doctor or physio rather than a coach. I can't tell you whether the ache is anything to worry about, and I won't guess at it.

What I can do is keep the training side moving around it. If you get the all-clear, or simply want to hold off on jumping and running for now, I'll set this week's conditioning up around rowing and whatever else you're comfortable with. Tell me what you want to avoid and how you're feeling about the rest, and I'll take it from there.
